title: Getting started with CFUestimatoR
text: CFUestimatoR estimates colony forming units (CFU) agar plate colony counts, using maximum likelihood estimators Martini et al. (2024). Please cite paper use CFUestimatoR. Martini KM, Boddu SS, Nemenman , Vega NM. 2024. Maximum likelihood estimators colony-forming units. Microbiology Spectrum 12(9):e03946-23. https://doi.org/10.1128/spectrum.03946-23

title: Getting started with CFUestimatoR
text: goal CFUestimatoR accurately precisely estimate density CFUs plate counts accounting different sources error (sample fluctuation, colony crowding, pipetting) sampling process, without discarding losing valuable data. CFUestimatoR offers two estimators: 1) Poisson estimator user-set crowding cutoff. Note: function can alos compute “naive” Poisson estimator setting thresholding value \(M\) Inf 2) maximum likelihood estimator (default) based probable number approach explicitely models process crowding.

title: Getting started with CFUestimatoR
text: Poisson model arguably common model calculating CFUs. Poisson assumes number colonies plate Poison distributed variation sampling mean colony count equal variance. likely estimator model just ratio total number colonies counted across plates divided total amount liquid plated. \[ r_{\text{mle}} = \frac{{\sum}_k n_{k}}{V \sum_k d_{k}} = \frac{\sum_k n_{k}}{\sum_k V_{k}}, \space \sigma = \frac{r_{\text{mle}}}{\sqrt{\sum_k n_{k}}} \] One weakness approach account event two individual cells land small enough area grow together countable single colony. paper refers process “crowding.” Poisson model can control crowding incorporating user-defined thresholding value \(M\), assumed crowding negligable need modeled. results following estimator. \[ r_{\text{mle}} = \frac{\sum_k (n_{k} \leq M) n_{k}}{\sum_k (n_{k} \leq M) V_{k}}, \space \sigma = \frac{r_{\text{mle}}}{\sqrt{\sum_k (n_{k} \leq M) n_{k}}} \] practive cutoff number \(N\) set number less crowding starts important. equivalent TNTC (“numerous count”) value commonly used microbiology. good default value \(N = 300\)

title: Getting started with CFUestimatoR
text: MLE estimator slightly complicated. plate divided \(N \approx \frac{A_{\text{plate}}}{A_{\text{colo⁢ny}}}\) regions, region size full colony. make assumptions one cell lands region \(N_{}\), colonies form cells grow together counted one colony. region, number cells landing region Poisson distributed parameter \(\lambda = \frac{d_{k} r V}{N}\). paper authors show framing equivalent MPN approach requires three paramters 1) total \(N_k\) virtual MPN tubes tested, 2) dilution volume original sample \(V_k\), 3) number \(n_k\) virtual tubes positive growth. Basically, probability \(n_k\) successes region \(N_i\) describable binomial distribution probability zero cells region \(N_i\) \(p_{0} = e^{- d_{k} r V / N_i}\) probability \(\geq 1\) landing region \(N_i\) \(p_{\gt} = e^{- d_{k} r V / N_i}\) resulting expression \[ p  n_{k}  =  \binom{N}{n_k} p_{>}^{n_{k}} p_{0}^{N - n_{k}} =  \binom{N}{n_k} ( 1 - e^{- \frac{d_{k}rV}{N}})^{n_{k}} e^{-d_{k}rV(N - n_{k})} \] MLE density can found form solving following eqation \(r\) \[ \sum_k \frac{d_{k} n_{k}}{N(1 - e^{-rd_{k} V / N})} = \sum_k d_{k} \] using estimator practice must choose value Estimated Maximum Colony Number (\(N\)). good starting estimate ratio area plate average colony size, standard 100 mm petri dish \(N=5000\)

title: Getting started with CFUestimatoR
text: cutoff number Poisson approach number less crowding starts important plate. "mle", good starting estimate ratio area plate average colony size. count N gives estimate Inf. Note: sometimes may use drop-spotting approach (e.g., Miles Misra) miniaturized assay. example ’ve plated 2 μl spot value 50 good choice. general, drop spotting approach usually produce noisier data.

title: Getting started with CFUestimatoR
text: estimators work directly vectors counts dilutions. three replicates three dilutions. Setting V = 1 returns CFU volume plated (.e., back calculation concentration original sample). Poisson estimator discards counts N, protects crowded plates. three plates 1e-5 dilution (counts 356 597) excluded, six plates 1e-7 1e-6 used. Setting N = Inf includes observations (even high colony counts) gives naive Poisson estimate paper. naive estimate lower cutoff estimate colonies crowded plates undercounted. maximum likelihood estimator uses data models saturation, needs cutoff need sensible N.
code: dilution <- rep(c(1e-7, 1e-6, 1e-5), each = 3) count <- c(5, 8, 4, 62, 77, 51, 456, 597, 356)  find_mle(count, dilution, N = 5000, V = 1) #>          r  stderr         type #> 1 50741067 1262704 ML_estimator find_poisson_cutoff(count, dilution, N = 300, V = 1) #>          r  stderr           type #> 1 62727273 4359847 poisson_cutoff find_poisson_cutoff(count, dilution, N = Inf, V = 1) #>          r  stderr           type #> 1 48528529 1207192 poisson_cutoff

title: Estimate CFU from a dilution series — estimate_cfu
text: data data frame one row per counted spot plate. Input data expected header row, e.g. read utils::read.csv() readr::read_csv(). count, dilution <tidy-select> single column holding colony counts single column holding dilution factors, e.g. count = n_colonies. Strings "n_colonies" also work. Default columns named count dilution. Dilutions must numeric (e.g. 1e-6). group <tidy-select> Columns group . combination tidyselect expressions can used, e.g. c(strain, rep), starts_with("treat"), (.character) all_of(vars). Leave NULL grouping. Strings "strain" also work. method Estimator use: "mle" find_mle() (default) "poisson" find_poisson_cutoff(). N Threshold passed chosen estimator. "mle", maximum number countable colonies (see find_mle()); defaults 5000, recommended 100 mm petri dishes. "poisson", counts N excluded (see find_poisson_cutoff()); defaults 300, also recommended 100 mm petri dishes. sampling_vol Volume plated spotted, milliliters (ml), used convert absolute CFU CFU/ml. Either single positive number applied rows (e.g. 0.002 2 ul spot), name column holding volume row (e.g. vol_plated_ml). Defaults 0.1 (100 ul). volume must constant within group.

title: Estimate CFU from a dilution series — estimate_cfu
